MY WEEKEND AND WHAT'S NEXT — a blog post by Leo, 13, from Manchester

Hi everyone! Last Saturday was a great day. In the morning, I went into the city with my brother. We watched a football match and our team won 2–1. I was so happy! After the match, we ate fish and chips near the stadium. In the evening, I felt tired but really happy.

Next month, my family is going to visit my grandparents in Wales. I am excited because we will go hiking in the mountains. I hope the weather will be sunny.

At the moment I am reading a book called "The Night Bus". It is exciting and a little bit scary. I think you would like it!

What about you? Write back soon!
